```python
class TypeTable:
    def __init__(self, definitions):
        self.definitions = {}
        for item in definitions:
            self.definitions[item['name']] = item
        self.cache = {}
    def get(self, name):
        cached = self.cache.get(name)
        if cached is not None: return cached
        definition = self.definitions[name]
        kind = definition['kind']
        if kind == 'bool': node = Bool(name)
        elif kind == 'char': node = Char(name)
        elif kind == 'int': node = Int(definition['bits'], name)
        elif kind == 'string': node = String(definition['maxsize'], name)
        elif kind == 'enum': node = Enum(name, definition['values'])
        elif kind == 'void': node = Void(name)
        elif kind == 'array':
            node = Array(None, definition['size'], name)
            node.element_type = self.get(definition['element'])
        elif kind == 'struct':
            node = Struct(name, {})
            fields = {}
            for (fname, ftype) in definition['fields']:
                fields[fname] = self.get(ftype)
            node.fields = fields
        elif kind == 'alias':
            node = Alias(name, None)
            node.type = self.get(definition['target'])
        else: raise ConfigError(...)
        self.cache[name] = node
        return node
```

```python
class PredicateCompiler:
    def __init__(self, types): self.types = types
    def compile(self, node, scope):
        if not isinstance(node, list) or not node: raise ConfigError
        head = node[0]
        if head == 'var': return Var(scope[node[1]], node[1])
        if head == 'const':
            t = self.types.get(node[1]); return Const(t, convert_constant(t, node[2]))
        if head == 'field':
            sub = self.compile(node[1], scope); inner=Type.inner(sub.type)
            return Field(inner.fields[node[2]], sub, node[2])
        if head == 'index':
            sub = self.compile(node[1], scope); inner=Type.inner(sub.type)
            return Index(inner.element_type, sub, node[2])
        if head == 'all':
            binding = node[1]; arr = self.compile(node[2], scope); inner = Type.inner(arr.type)
            inner_scope = dict(scope); inner_scope[binding] = inner.element_type
            body = self.compile(node[3], inner_scope)
            return Forall(Bool(), arr, body, binding)
        if head == 'match':
            sub = self.compile(node[1], scope)
            return Match(Bool(), sub, compile_pattern(node[2]))
        if head == 'not':
            return Not(Bool(), self.compile(node[1], scope))
        op = canonical_op(head)
        if op in BINOPS:
            left = self.compile(node[1], scope); right = self.compile(node[2], scope)
            if op in ('add','sub'):
                t = Type.inner(left.type)
                if not isinstance(t, Int): t = Type.inner(right.type)
                return Binop(t, op, left, right)
            return Binop(Bool(), op, left, right)
        raise ConfigError('unknown expression form')
```
